text: APPROVE: `IsWanted` preserves the original logic (skip non-objects, accept the first object when no version is requested, otherwise require an exact ordinal `num` match). That removes the deeply nested branches from `Parse`, which lowers its complexity, and the new private static helper uses valid, nullable-safe syntax so it should build cleanly. I judged the complexity and build from the diff alone, without running the analyzer or the build.
